candidate.subject: mathematics
candidate.question: Resolve 3/(x² + x − 2) into partial fractions.
candidate.ai_explanation: Factor the denominator as (x−1)(x+2). Writing 3=A(x+2)+B(x−1), x=1 gives A=1 and x=−2 gives B=−1. Thus the partial fractions are 1/(x−1)−1/(x+2), with x≠1,−2.
